Senses.PreferredTarget: the lineage's treasury of the true eye of the teaching
AlternateTargets: the treasury of the true teaching-eye
SearchAliases: treasury of the true Dharma eye
storehouse of the true teaching eye
Senses.Explanation: The treasury of the true eye of the teaching is what the Chan record says is entrusted through the lineage. In the flower story, the Buddha says that he possesses it and entrusts it to Mahakasyapa. Buddhanandi repeats the handover as an instruction that it must not be cut off. Linji Yixuan calls it his own at death and publicly tests Sansheng Huiran's claim not to destroy it. Wumen Huikai turns the founding story back into a question: how is it transmitted? Baiyun Shouduan retells the flower exchange and says that it has passed down in succession to the present. The record therefore supplies both the inherited transmission claim and named masters' challenges to how such transmission can be said to occur.
Senses.Note: This is the transmitted phrase, not the separately attested book title. Raw-string counts combine both referents: 1,381 occurrences in 279 allowlisted texts. The entry reports the record's deployments without ruling whether Wumen's question confirms or defeats the transmission claim.

Occurrences.Kwic: 世尊曰。吾有正法眼藏。涅槃妙心。實相無相。微妙法門。不立文字。教外別傳。付囑摩訶迦葉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Sakyamuni Buddha section: The Buddha says that he has the treasury of the true eye of the teaching and entrusts it to Mahakasyapa.

Occurrences.Kwic: 正法眼藏作麼生傳。設使迦葉不笑。正法眼藏又作麼生傳。若道正法眼藏有傳授。黃面老子誑謼閭閻。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Gateless Barrier (無門關), case six: Wumen Huikai asks how the treasury is transmitted and presses both the claim that it was transmitted and the counterclaim that it was not.

Occurrences.Kwic: 我今以如來正法眼藏付囑於汝勿令斷絕。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Jingde-era Record of the Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄), section on the eighth patriarch Buddhanandi: Buddhanandi entrusts the treasury to Buddhamitra and says not to let it be cut off.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師臨遷化時據坐云：「吾滅後不得滅却吾正法眼藏。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Linji Huizhao of Zhenzhou (鎮州臨濟慧照禪師語錄): at death Linji Yixuan tells the assembly not to destroy his treasury of the true eye of the teaching.

Occurrences.Kwic: 三聖出云：「爭敢滅却和尚正法眼藏？」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Linji Huizhao of Zhenzhou (鎮州臨濟慧照禪師語錄): Sansheng Huiran steps forward and asks how he would dare destroy his teacher's treasury of the true eye of the teaching.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云：「誰知吾正法眼藏向這瞎驢邊滅却。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Linji Huizhao of Zhenzhou (鎮州臨濟慧照禪師語錄): after Sansheng Huiran answers Linji's test with a shout, Linji Yixuan gives the final verdict that his treasury will be destroyed with this blind donkey.

Occurrences.Kwic: 世尊道。吾有正法眼藏。分付摩訶大迦葉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), section on Baiyun Shouduan: in Baiyun Shouduan's inaugural sermon, he quotes The Buddha saying that he has the treasury of the true eye of the teaching and entrusts it to Mahakasyapa; Baiyun then says that it has passed down to the present.

Senses.PreferredTarget: the book Treasury of the True Eye of the Teaching
AlternateTargets: Treasury of the True Eye of the Teaching
SearchAliases: Treasury of the True Dharma Eye
Senses.Explanation: The same graphs also name a book. Zhanran Yuancheng's preface calls itself the Preface to the Recut Treasury of the True Eye of the Teaching, then says that Dahui Zonggao selected material from the five houses, gathered more than one hundred masters into fascicles, and gave the resulting book this title. A work that can be compiled, recut, and prefaced is a different thing from the lineage possession named in the first sense.
Senses.Note: This title sense remains provisional because both exact anchors belong to one independent allowlisted work. The two PreferredTargets are distinguishable without capitalization alone: one names a lineage possession; this one explicitly names a book.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: In his Extensive Record (湛然圓澄禪師語錄), Zhanran Yuancheng heads the document Preface to the Recut Treasury of the True Eye of the Teaching.

Occurrences.Kwic: 故我大慧老人承悲願力，運無畏心，決擇五家，提挈最正者凡百餘人，裒以成帙，目曰正法眼藏。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the same preface in his Extensive Record (湛然圓澄禪師語錄), Zhanran Yuancheng says that Dahui Zonggao selected more than one hundred masters, gathered the material into fascicles, and titled the book Treasury of the True Eye of the Teaching.
